description_excerpt: Job Description ABOUT YOUR ROLE The Plate Designer utilizes current graphic design technology and computer software packages to produce a variety of different products . The individual originates design, art and copy layouts, determines style, size and arrangement of type and illustrations and provides instructions or directly assembles and prepares final layouts for printer. The Plate Designer will be responsible for following the sampling process, including color matching and reviewing samples to ensure they meet customer requirements.
